sa_actionActivateText: SourceAnalytix calculates again with the stored settings.
sa_actionAlignText: Set the total to the value your meter shows.
sa_actionDeactivateText: SourceAnalytix stops calculating. The data stays.
sa_actionDeleteText: Remove the folder of the source with all values and years.
sa_actionRecalcText: Recalculate costs with the price history. Consumption stays the same.
sa_actionRecoverText: Run a missed day, week or month rollover, e.g. after an outage.
sa_actionSwapText: Enter the end reading of the old meter and the start reading of the new one. The total continues.
sa_actionSwitchText: Use another datapoint and keep the data.
sa_alignExpert: Sets cumulativeReading and valueAtDeviceReset (now %s, new %s) and moves the start values by the same amount.
sa_alignPreview2: Today's consumption stays %s %s. Past periods stay unchanged.
sa_alignQuestion: What does your meter show now?
sa_basicFeeTwiceHint: %s already books the basic fee of this price definition. If it is on here too, it counts twice.
sa_check_resetDetectionOff: No drops to 0 without reset detection
sa_dailyCounterWarning: This datapoint looks like a daily counter that drops to 0 every night. Better use the total counter. If there is none, answer "Does the value sometimes drop to 0?" with Yes in the next step.
sa_deleteHint: Only want to pause and keep the data? Use "Deactivate".
sa_deleteSettings: the SourceAnalytix settings of the datapoint
sa_errAboveTotal: Must not be larger than the current reading (%s %s).
sa_errLooksLikeWh: Looks like Wh – did you mean %s %s?
sa_errOrder: Must not be larger than the start value of %s (%s).
sa_errOutputId: Only letters, digits, _ and - are allowed.
sa_errOutputIdUsed: Another source already uses this ID.
sa_err_invalidDate: The date is not valid or lies in the future.
sa_err_invalidNewStart: The start reading is not valid.
sa_err_invalidValue: Please enter a valid meter reading.
sa_err_negativeValue: The meter reading must not be negative.
sa_err_oldEndBelowTotal: The end reading is lower than the last known total.
sa_err_outputNotFound: There is no folder for this source.
sa_err_powerSource: Power sources have no meter swap.
sa_err_priceMissing: This price definition does not exist.
sa_err_unitIncompatible: Unit does not match the price definition.
sa_includeBasicFee: Include the basic fee of this price definition
sa_instantHint: Actions with ⚡ apply immediately in the running adapter, without saving and without restart.
sa_kindMeterText: The value keeps rising, like an electricity meter (e.g. Wh, kWh, m³).
sa_kindPowerText: The value shows the current power (W). SourceAnalytix calculates the consumption from it.
sa_loadFailedText: The instance did not answer. Check that it is running and try again.
sa_nameHelp: Name of the folder with the values: %s
sa_needsInstance: The overview needs a running instance.
sa_newPriceHint: Create a new price definition in the tab "Price definitions" (saving restarts the adapter).
sa_noCandidates: No matching datapoints found. Use "Select object".
sa_noPrices: There is no price definition yet. Create one in the tab "Price definitions" first.
sa_notRunningText: Instant actions are locked until the instance runs. You can still change and save settings.
sa_problem_offsetAboveTotal: Total does not match the meter
sa_problem_powerSilent: Power source has not reported for a long time
sa_problem_resetDetectionOff: Meter drops to 0, reset detection is off
sa_problem_stringValue: Datapoint delivers text instead of a number
sa_problem_unitIncompatible: Unit does not match the price
sa_recalcFuture: The date must not lie in the future.
sa_recalcNote: Consumption stays the same. The costs are calculated again from the consumption of each period and the price history. Values in a history (e.g. InfluxDB) stay as they are.
sa_resetQuestion: Does the value sometimes drop to 0, e.g. after a power failure?
sa_resetShelly: Shelly and Tasmota often start at 0 after a restart. That is why "Yes" is preselected.
sa_setupPriceHint: Create the price in the tab "Price definitions"; the wizard then offers it.
sa_startBlocked: The start value for %s does not fit. Fix it to continue.
sa_startInfo: Enter the meter reading at the beginning of each period (0:00), in %s. Empty fields start now.
sa_start_nowText: All periods start at 0 now. Simplest and always right.
sa_start_since: Include consumption since the start of the period
sa_start_sinceText: You know the meter readings at the beginning of day, week, month, quarter or year.
sa_suggest_basicFeeTwice: Switch it off for one of the sources (also booked by: %s).
sa_suggest_noPrice: Choose a price or create one in the tab "Price definitions".
sa_suggest_offsetAboveTotal: "Align meter reading". Otherwise SourceAnalytix realigns the offset with the next value.
sa_suggest_powerSilent: Check the device. Long gaps are extrapolated; the setting "maximum gap" discards them.
sa_suggest_sourceDeleted: Deactivate or delete the data. Switching the datapoint is planned.
sa_suggest_startValue: Check the start values: at most the current reading, in the calculation unit.
sa_suggest_stringValue: Since v0.6.2 SourceAnalytix reads numbers from text itself. A datapoint of type number is better.
sa_swapDone: Meter swap applied. Total continues from %s %s.
sa_swapExpert: Sets valueAtDeviceReset = end reading − start reading. Values that still come from the old meter are ignored until the new meter reports.
sa_swapOldEndLow: End reading is lower than the last known total (%s %s).
sa_swapOldEndMissing: Enter the end reading of the old meter.
sa_swapPreview2: Then it continues with the new meter from %s %s.
sa_unitIntro: The datapoint reports the unit "%s". Choose the unit it counts in. Spellings like m3 and kwh are recognised automatically.
sa_wizardTotalCounter: Use the total counter, not a daily counter. Total counters keep rising; daily counters drop to 0 every night.
sa_wizardWaiting: %s is active. Waiting for the first value …
